messages.content: PR #310 review round 1: (1) make CacheConfig immutable, (2) use constructor injection in OrderService, (3) rename the property `ttl` to `cache.ttl-seconds`. Address them.

Done: CacheConfig fields are final and set through the constructor; OrderService uses constructor injection; the property is now cache.ttl-seconds in application.yml and in the @Value usage. mvn test: 142 passed, 0 failed.
Round 2: the reviewer asked to default cache.ttl-seconds to 60 when it isn't set.
Done: @Value("${cache.ttl-seconds:60}") in CacheConfig, plus a test for the default. mvn test: 143 passed, 0 failed.

Round 3: the reviewer wants a README note about the new property cache.ttl-seconds. Separately, CI's checkstyle job just failed on an unused import in CacheConfig.java, which came in with your round-2 change. I haven't fixed either. Where do we stand?

required_facts: Two items are open: a README note for cache.ttl-seconds (reviewer request) and the checkstyle failure for an unused import in CacheConfig.java
The checkstyle failure came in with the round-2 change, and the earlier mvn test runs did not cover checkstyle
Neither item has been fixed yet
critical_omissions: Saying CI is green or the PR is ready to merge
Claiming the unused import or the README note was already handled
unnecessary_repetition: The round-1 changes (immutability, constructor injection, property rename)
The round-2 default value and its test
The test counts of earlier rounds (142 and 143)
